messages.text:
The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Fixed the beeping by removing the match and win tones from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Match handling, visual feedback, and announcements remain in place.

Verification passed: locked install, type check, 138 unit and static tests, and all 76 browser tests, including the complete-game silence check.

The repository-wide formatting check reports 13 existing files outside this change. The changed file passes its formatting check.
